findings.detail: Nested scratch TMPDIR allows Node runtime resolution to find scratch/node_modules/zod/index.js and vitest/dist/index.js outside each fixture, despite TypeScript paths pointing to local inert source. Checker correctly emits MODULE_OUTSIDE_REPOSITORY. In the authorized sibling TMPDIR, the same runtime lookup is ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND and existing TS source projection resolves to local stubs. All 224 unchanged tests pass under sealed JSdom configuration; all earlier failing assertions and logs are retained.
findings.limits: These fixtures are not portable to arbitrary temporary roots under installed dependencies. This review does not weaken that provenance diagnostic or claim the initial runs passed.
